Differential Equations
LEARNINGOBJECTIVE
FUN-7.A
Interpret verbal statements
of problems as differential
equations involving a
derivative expression.
ESSENTIALKNOWLEDGE
FUN-7.A.1
Differential equations relate a function of
an independent variable and the function’s
derivatives.
ENDURINGUNDERSTANDING
FUN-7
Solving differential equations allows us to determine functions and develop models.
